summary: Quhuo Ltd (Nasdaq: QH) filed a Form 6-K reporting the departure of two independent directors (Ms. Jie Jiao and Mr. Jingchuan Li) due to term expiration, with no dispute or disagreement, and the appointment of two new independent directors (Mr. King Fui Lee and Mr. Ke Zhang) effective July 9, 2026. The changes are routine board refreshment, not a forced or abrupt departure. The filing serves as a foreign private issuer report under US securities laws. No consideration, premiums, or deal mechanics are involved. As a non-US filer, this mirrors US Form 8-K Item 5.02 requirements. What to watch: any subsequent governance or strategic shifts.
